entities.name: Yoshio Shinozuka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yoshio Shinozuka was a Japanese Imperial Army soldier who served as an army medic with a top secret biological warfare group called Unit 731 in World War II. He was a member of the Association of Returnees from China.
